title: Paphos, Paphos District — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Paphos, Paphos District: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Paphos is a city in Paphos District with a population of 66,000. A UNESCO World Heritage city on Cyprus’ southwest coast, legendary birthplace of Aphrodite, with stunning mosaics and ancient tombs. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 310 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
